arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Values (in millions)
fy2011 = 135031
fy2019 = 35810

# Number of years from FY2011 to FY2019
n = 8

# CAGR = (Ending/Beginning)^(1/n) - 1
cagr = (fy2019 / fy2011) ** (1/n) - 1

# Annual decay factor = 1 + CAGR
decay_factor = 1 + cagr

# Arc elasticity using midpoint percentage change
# Formula: ((Q2 - Q1) / Q_avg) / ((T2 - T1) / T_avg)
# Where Q_avg = (Q1 + Q2) / 2, T_avg = (T1 + T2) / 2
Q1 = fy2011
Q2 = fy2019
T1 = 2011
T2 = 2019

Q_avg = (Q1 + Q2) / 2
T_avg = (T1 + T2) / 2

pct_change_Q = (Q2 - Q1) / Q_avg
pct_change_T = (T2 - T1) / T_avg

arc_elasticity = pct_change_Q / pct_change_T

print(f"FY2011: {fy2011}")
print(f"FY2019: {fy2019}")
print(f"Years: {n}")
print(f"CAGR: {cagr:.10f}")
print(f"Annual decay factor: {decay_factor:.10f}")
print(f"Arc elasticity: {arc_elasticity:.10f}")

# Round to 3 decimal places
print("\n--- Rounded to 3 decimal places ---")
print(f"CAGR: {round(cagr, 3)}")
print(f"Annual decay factor: {round(decay_factor, 3)}")
print(f"Arc elasticity: {round(arc_elasticity, 3)}")
EOF
